mechanism: Minocycline may increase intracranial pressure and risk of benign intracranial hypertension, which is potentiated by corticosteroid use; additionally, both agents may affect immune response and increase infection risk.
action: Monitor for signs of intracranial hypertension (headache, visual disturbances, papilledema); consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure appropriate infection prophylaxis if prolonged corticosteroid therapy required.
